title: VIX futures and options February 2028 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the same session as the January 2028 FOMC minutes, and the measuring stick for this calendar's one live volatility statistic
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED, because no published primary reaches February 2028 and this entry says so rather than implying otherwise. The standing rule -- the monthly VIX settlement is the Wednesday 30 days before the following month's monthly option expiration, itself the third Friday of that month moved a day earlier when a holiday intervenes -- gives 30 days before Friday 2028-03-17 (the third Friday of March 2028) = Wednesday 2028-02-16. TWO INDEPENDENT VALIDATIONS OF THE RULE WERE RUN BY THIS SESSION ON 2026-09-09 AND BOTH ARE REPORTED WITH THEIR FAILURES. (1) Against this calendar's own 13 canonical vix-expiration-* entries the rule reproduces 11, the two misses being already-documented ones: 2027-05-18 (confirmed at rule-minus-one, the Juneteenth-observed adjustment) and 2027-12-15 (the SEVEN-day discrepancy vix-expiration-2027-12-15.json records verbatim and does not resolve). (2) Against the OCC's own expiration calendar, optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), whose 36 'Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading' rows span 2025-01-16 -> 2027-12-16 and stop there -- the third-Friday rule reproduces 32 of 36, all four misses being holiday adjustments this session checked by name (Good Friday 2025-04-18; Juneteenth 2025-06-19, 2026-06-19 and observed 2027-06-18). FEBRUARY IS THE CLEAN MONTH IN BOTH CHECKS: the rule is 3-for-3 on February in the OCC file (2025-02-20, 2026-02-19, 2027-02-18 each exactly the third Friday minus one) and 3-for-3 on this calendar's February entries, and February carries no holiday that can move the anchor, because Washington's Birthday is always a Monday. Filed estimate on that extrapolation, on the OCC file ending 14 months before this date, and on this lane's standing no-self-confirm limit for an event discovered in-sweep. Promotion requires reading a CBOE or OCC primary published closer to the date, never recomputing the rule. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2028-02-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), at D+0 from that release -- the same session, not merely nearby. LOAD-BEARING, and the proposer states exactly how far. fomc-minutes-2027-11-17.md established this calendar's one surviving volatility statistic as a settlement split, and the proposing lane replicated it independently on 2026-09-09 from its own 157-release census and its own settlement rule, landing on the same 50 collisions: 50 on-settlement releases run 50.0% VIX-down (P = 0.570 against a 54.4% universe base rate) against 107 off-settlement at 71.0% (P = 0.0005), the split at P = 0.0014. The January minutes sub-class is the family's most collided by a wide margin -- 13 of 18 (72.2%) against 31.8% family-wide -- because a D+21 release from a last-Wednesday-of-January decision and a VIX settlement 30 days before the third Friday of March are both Wednesdays inside a narrow February band. So whether 2028-02-16 is on- or off-settlement is precisely the question the family's live statistic turns on, and this calendar carried no 2028 settlement entry at all. THE PROPOSER DRAWS NO TRADE FROM IT AND SAYS WHY: at n = 13 the January on-settlement half prints 69.2% VIX-down rather than the mechanism's 50.0%, P = 0.266 against the family's on-settlement pool -- underpowered, neither confirming nor refuting -- and once matched on BOTH the calendar window (Feb 15-21) and settlement status, the class is a perfect null against its 15 comparable sessions (P = 1.000 VIX-down, P = 0.914 mean |S&P|). ALSO WORTH KNOWING FOR ANY LATER LANE: the SOQ prints at the OPEN and the minutes drop at 14:00 ET, so a same-session collision is sequential, not simultaneous, and the settlement is already resolved hours before the release. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is settlement-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
